name: Thief
summary: The classic adventurer: quick hands, climbing and jumping, and a knack for magic items.

feature.name: Fast Hands
feature.summary: Bonus Action: Sleight of Hand (locks, traps, pockets), Utilize, or use a magic item.
feature.text: As a Bonus Action you can make a Dexterity (Sleight of Hand) check to pick a lock, disarm a trap or pick a pocket, take the Utilize action, or take the Magic action to use a magic item.

feature.name: Second-Story Work
feature.summary: Climb Speed equal to your Speed; jump distance uses Dexterity.
feature.text: You have a Climb Speed equal to your Speed, and you can use Dexterity instead of Strength to work out your jump distance.

feature.name: Supreme Sneak
feature.summary: Stealth Attack Cunning Strike (1d6): stay Invisible from Hide if you end the turn behind cover.
feature.text: You gain a new Cunning Strike option, Stealth Attack (cost 1d6): if you have the Invisible condition from the Hide action, this attack doesn't end it as long as you finish the turn behind Three-Quarters Cover or Total Cover.

feature.name: Use Magic Device
feature.summary: Attune to four items, maybe save charges, and use any Spell Scroll with Intelligence.

feature.name: Thief's Reflexes
feature.summary: Take two turns in the first round of combat (second at Initiative - 10).
